editorial:

You get to follow James Becket, a scary guy who killed his own dad and is now hunting down his ex-wife, Tess. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where the bad guy is always one step ahead. T. Dillon in her corner. He is a former cop who teaches her how to fight back, and the two of them end up falling in love while trying to survive this nightmare. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure as the killer closes in.

What really works here is the tension and the way the action picks up toward the end. T. to finally catch Becket. While some parts of the plot feel a bit predictable, the final showdown makes up for it. If you love thrillers with a bit of romance and plenty of suspense, you should definitely check this out.
